projectDescription: A self-hosted JavaScript library that brings RetroArch-powered emulation to the web browser, supporting 30+ classic gaming systems.
keyFeatures: 30+ emulated gaming systems via RetroArch/libretro cores
Configurable via simple window.EJS_* global variables
Virtual gamepad support for mobile browsers
IndexedDB-based caching for ROMs, cores, and BIOS files
Save state and save file management
Stable, Latest, and Nightly release channels
publicApiSurface: window.EJS_player — CSS selector for the emulator container element
window.EJS_gameUrl — URL or File object of the ROM to load
window.EJS_core — Emulation core/system identifier (e.g. 'nes', 'snes', 'gba')
window.EJS_pathtodata — Path to the EmulatorJS data/ directory
window.EJS_biosUrl — URL or File object of the required BIOS file
window.EJS_gameName — Display name of the game
window.EJS_color — UI accent color (hex string)
window.EJS_startOnLoaded — Auto-start emulation when loaded (boolean)
window.EJS_fullscreenOnLoaded — Auto-enter fullscreen when loaded (boolean)
window.EJS_volume — Initial volume level (0.0–1.0)
window.EJS_defaultControls — Default controller button mappings
window.EJS_Buttons — Button visibility/customization options
window.EJS_VirtualGamepadSettings — Virtual gamepad configuration
window.EJS_netplayServer — WebSocket URL of the netplay server
window.EJS_netplayICEServers — ICE servers for WebRTC netplay
window.EJS_cacheConfig — Cache configuration object {enabled, cacheMaxSizeMB, cacheMaxAgeMins}
window.EJS_cheats — Array of cheat codes to preload
window.EJS_loadStateURL — URL of a save state to load on start
window.EJS_language — Language code for UI localization
window.EJS_shaders — Additional shader definitions
window.EJS_backgroundImage — Background image URL for the emulator UI
window.EJS_hideSettings — Array of settings keys to hide from the settings menu
window.EJS_ready — Callback fired when emulator is ready
window.EJS_onGameStart — Callback fired when game starts
window.EJS_onLoadState — Callback fired when a state is loaded
window.EJS_onSaveState — Callback fired when a state is saved
window.EJS_onSaveUpdate — Callback fired when save data is updated
window.EJS_emulator.on(event, callback) — Register event listener on EmulatorJS instance
window.EJS_emulator.enableSaveUpdateEvent() — Enable save update events
